scenario_text:
This is the data tier for a clinical records application used by about 30
clinicians concurrently. Mixed read and write, roughly 30 GB of patient
records. Host has 6 GB RAM and 4 vCPU. We handle protected health
information and must satisfy HIPAA: encryption in transit, strong
authentication, and audit logging of access. Backups are mandatory.
